settings.heading: WARRANTY POLICY
settings.content:
# Built to Carry On.

We make our gear to be used — stuffed in pockets, tossed in bags, dropped on trails, and carried every single day. If something we made fails because of how we made it, we'll make it right. For life.

That's the Thread Limited Lifetime Warranty.

---

## WHAT'S COVERED

**The short version:** if it's our fault, it's on us.

We cover defects in materials and workmanship for the practical lifetime of the product. That means things like:

  • Seams that come apart under normal use
  • Zippers or hardware that fail without abuse
  • Stitching, binding, or construction flaws
  • Materials that break down way before they should

If your product has a covered defect, we'll repair it or replace it with the same product — or if we no longer make it (we retire styles pretty often... it keeps things fresh), we'll swap it for a current product of equal value.

---

## WHAT'S NOT COVERED

Honestly, we want to be upfront here so there are no surprises. Gear that's genuinely lived a full life looks different than gear that failed early. Not covered:

  • **Normal wear and tear** — fabric fading, elastic relaxing over years of use, corners softening, zipper pulls wearing smooth. That's not a defect. That's a life well carried.
  • **Damage from misuse or accidents** — washing machine casualties, pets, fire, your car door, etc.
  • **Modifications or repairs** done by anyone other than us
  • **Cosmetic damage** that doesn't affect function — scuffs, stains, scratches
  • **Lost or stolen products** (we wish)
  • **Products purchased from unauthorized sellers** — buy from threadwallets.com or an authorized retailer and you're covered

---

## HOW IT WORKS

  1. **Snap a few photos** of the issue
  2. **Fill out the claim form** below — takes about 2 minutes
  3. **Our team reviews it** — usually within 2–3 business days
  4. **We make it right** — repair, replacement, or a swap for something of equal value from the current line

settings.heading: WARRANTY POLICY
settings.content:
No receipt? No problem in most cases — but proof of purchase helps us move faster, especially for retail purchases.

---

## THE WHY

We could have written a warranty full of loopholes. We didn't want to. When you buy Thread, you're not just buying a wallet or a bag — you're trusting us with the stuff you carry every day. That trust should last as long as the product does.

Carry On.

---

## THE FINE PRINT

*This section reads more formal because it has to. Everything above still applies.*

This Limited Lifetime Warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship for the practical lifetime of the product. "Lifetime" refers to the reasonable expected life of the product under normal use, not the lifetime of the purchaser. Product lifespan varies by use, conditions, and care.

This warranty applies only to products purchased from Thread Wallets or an authorized Thread retailer, and extends only to the original owner. It is non-transferable. Proof of purchase may be required.

Thread Wallets will determine, at its sole discretion, whether a product qualifies as defective under this warranty. If a defect is confirmed, Thread will repair the product or replace it with the same or a comparable product of equal value from the current product line. Repair or replacement is the exclusive remedy under this warranty. Refunds are not provided under warranty claims (see our Return Policy for returns within the standard return window).

This warranty does not cover damage resulting from normal wear and tear, misuse, neglect, accident, improper care, unauthorized modification or repair, or cosmetic damage that does not impair function.

This warranty gives you specific legal rights, and you may also have other rights that vary by state or country. Some jurisdictions do not allow limitations on implied warranties or the exclusion of incidental or consequential damages, so some of the above limitations may not apply to you. To the extent permitted by law, Thread Wallets disclaims liability for incidental and consequential damages.

Questions? Reach out to contact@threadwallets.com — a real human will get back to you.

settings.heading: Wallets
settings.content:
Use recommended amount of cards in each product:

  • Phone case: 2-4 cards/cash
  • Elastic: 2-10 cards/cash
  • Vertical: 2-8 cards/cash
  • Bifold: 4-10 cards/cash
  • Magnetic: 8-10 cards/cash
  • Pull cards/cash up and not out.

 

HOW TO CLEAN

  • Elastic products are washable, remove metal key rings to prevent rust.
  • The logo is designed to withstand machine washing, but there is always the small possibility that they can detach just from everyday wear and tear!
  • Leather and magnetic products are not machine-washable, but any elastic on our bifolds, verticals, phone cases, or magnetic wallets can be spot-treated.

settings.heading: Lanyards/Keychains
settings.content:
Lanyards and keychains are made to hold the essentials, but they are not built to hold everything. When the clasps are weighed down with multiple items, there is an increased chance that something will fall off.

We have found that the lanyards function best with just a few keys, a Thread wallet, and Thread lip balm holder!

For keychains, your keys and any other items are meant to be attached to the keyring end of the keychain, and the clip can be attached to bags and belt loops.

 

HOW TO CLEAN

  • Hand wash and spot clean, being careful to avoid getting the leather wet.

settings.heading: Bags
settings.content:
HOW TO CLEAN

  • Tote Bag: Do not machine wash, do not bleach, do not tumble dry, do not iron. Hand wash and dry flat.
  • Crossbody bags, fanny packs, & backpacks: Machine wash; we recommend using a delicate setting in cold water, dry flat.
  • Clear Crossbody Bag & Fanny Pack: Hand wash only, wipe clean.
  • Honey Crossbody Bag: Hand wash only.
  • ﻿Off-white Crossbody Bag & Fanny Pack: Hand wash only.
